records.title: Polyline Path Masked Attention for Vision Transformer
records.reason: Polyline Path Masked Attention is a Vision Transformer attention design for image processing; no LLM/language-model inference evaluation is described.

records.title: Corrector Sampling in Language Models
records.reason: RPT revisits previously sampled tokens to reduce generation errors and improve quality; the paper describes it as often a better yet more expensive procedure than next-token sampling, so it does not establish an efficiency improvement.

records.title: Spine-Free Networks for Large Language Model Training
records.reason: 一次出版社ページ https://doi.org/10.1109/MM.2025.3540663 を開いたが、読める要旨/本文を取得できず、入力要旨だけで対象外とは判定しない。一次証拠を照合できないためborderline。

records.title: Unveiling the Potential of BERT-family: A New Recipe for Building Scalable, General and Competitive Large Language Models
records.reason: BiGLM introduces a bidirectional masked pretraining recipe for general language models. Full text evaluates capability and training/scaling choices rather than serving efficiency; connection to speculative decoding is indirect.

records.title: LAD: LoRA-Adapted Diffusion
records.reason: LAD adapts LLaMA with LoRA for masked diffusion generation, but the full paper is a demo and does not directly evaluate inference latency, throughput or memory; its efficiency claim is principally avoiding training from scratch.
